```{r}
#| label: novice-expert-schemas
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
source(here::here("resources/viz-setup.R"))

set.seed(42)

# --- Novice: scattered, unconnected nodes ---
n_nodes <- 9
novice_nodes <- tibble(
  x = c(0.8, 2.5, 4.2, 1.2, 3.0, 4.8, 0.5, 2.8, 4.5),
  y = c(4.2, 4.8, 4.0, 2.5, 2.8, 2.2, 1.0, 0.8, 1.2),
  label = c("Fakt A", "Fakt B", "Fakt C",
            "Regel 1", "Regel 2", "Regel 3",
            "Def. X", "Def. Y", "Def. Z")
)

# --- Expert: clustered, interconnected schemas ---
# Cluster 1 (top-left)
# Cluster 2 (top-right)
# Cluster 3 (bottom-center)
expert_nodes <- tibble(
  x = c(1.0, 2.0, 1.5,    3.8, 4.8, 4.3,    2.2, 3.2, 2.7) + 6.5,
  y = c(4.5, 4.5, 3.5,    4.5, 4.5, 3.5,    1.5, 1.5, 0.5),
  label = novice_nodes$label,
  cluster = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3)
)

# Edges within clusters
expert_edges <- tibble(
  x    = c(1.0, 2.0, 1.0,   3.8, 4.8, 3.8,   2.2, 3.2, 2.2) + 6.5,
  xend = c(2.0, 1.5, 1.5,   4.8, 4.3, 4.3,   3.2, 2.7, 2.7) + 0,
  y    = c(4.5, 4.5, 4.5,   4.5, 4.5, 4.5,   1.5, 1.5, 1.5),
  yend = c(4.5, 3.5, 3.5,   4.5, 3.5, 3.5,   1.5, 0.5, 0.5)
)

# Edges between clusters (cross-links)
expert_cross <- tibble(
  x    = c(2.0, 1.5, 4.3) + 6.5,
  xend = c(3.8, 2.7, 3.2) + 6.5,
  y    = c(4.5, 3.5, 3.5),
  yend = c(4.5, 1.5, 1.5)
)

# Cluster background rectangles
cluster_bg <- tibble(
  xmin = c(0.4, 3.2, 1.6) + 6.5,
  xmax = c(2.6, 5.4, 3.8) + 6.5,
  ymin = c(3.0, 3.0, -0.1),
  ymax = c(5.1, 5.1, 2.1),
  label = c("Schema 1", "Schema 2", "Schema 3")
)

p <- ggplot() +
  # --- LEFT PANEL: Novice ---
  annotate("rect", xmin = -0.3, xmax = 5.7, ymin = -0.5, ymax = 5.8,
           fill = "#f8f9fa", color = "#e5e7eb", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.7, y = 5.5, label = "Anfänger:in",
           size = 5.5, fontface = "bold", color = color_negative) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.7, y = -0.2, label = "Isolierte Fakten",
           size = 3.8, fontface = "italic", color = color_neutral) +
  geom_point(data = novice_nodes, aes(x = x, y = y),
             size = 8, color = color_negative, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = novice_nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            size = 2.8, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +

  # --- RIGHT PANEL: Expert ---
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.3, xmax = 12.3, ymin = -0.5, ymax = 5.8,
           fill = "#f8f9fa", color = "#e5e7eb", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 9.3, y = 5.5, label = "Expert:in",
           size = 5.5, fontface = "bold", color = color_positive) +
  annotate("text", x = 9.3, y = -0.2, label = "Vernetzte Schemas",
           size = 3.8, fontface = "italic", color = color_neutral) +

  # Cluster backgrounds
  geom_rect(data = cluster_bg,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = color_positive, alpha = 0.08,
            color = color_positive, linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(data = cluster_bg,
            aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = ymax + 0.15, label = label),
            size = 3, color = color_positive, fontface = "italic") +

  # Intra-cluster edges
  geom_segment(data = expert_edges,
               aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
               color = color_positive, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +

  # Cross-cluster edges
  geom_segment(data = expert_cross,
               aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
               color = color_positive, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.4,
               linetype = "dotted") +

  # Expert nodes
  geom_point(data = expert_nodes, aes(x = x, y = y),
             size = 8, color = color_positive, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(data = expert_nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            size = 2.8, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +

  # Arrow between panels
  annotate("segment", x = 5.7, xend = 6.3, y = 2.65, yend = 2.65,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
           color = brand_dark, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 6.0, y = 3.1, label = "Übung &\nFeedback",
           size = 3.2, color = brand_dark, fontface = "bold",
           lineheight = 0.85) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 12.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.6, 5.9), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Gleiche Hardware, unterschiedliche Software",
    subtitle = "Experten haben kein grösseres Arbeitsgedächtnis, sondern besser organisierte Wissensstrukturen"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", size = 16, color = brand_dark,
      hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11, color = color_neutral,
      hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

p
```
